Who this is for You are: - A finance professional, controller, accounting specialist, or similar - Based in the EU or UK - With several years of experience in finance, accounting, or business analysis - Skilled with modern financial tools, IFRS/local GAAP, and best practices - Comfortable identifying methodological flaws and compliance concerns - Available 8 to 20 hours per week - Able to start in the coming weeks This role is fully remote and flexible—perfect alongside your existing commitments. Why join? - Flexible hours - Fully remote - Apply your finance expertise to advance AI systems - Contribute to widely used AI products - Clear project scope and structured onboarding - Potential for long-term collaboration based on performance How to Apply: After applying, you’ll receive an email detailing the steps to: - ⁠Complete a short written assessment - Participate in an AI-powered interview Important: Your application is only complete once you finish all steps via the email link. Please note: these AI Lab missions are not traditional job openings with fixed start dates. Project demand is highly dynamic and matching depends on your expertise, availability, and current AI Lab needs. Some experts are matched within days, while others may wait longer for a suitable project. ----------------------------------------- NOTE At 10x, there are two types of opportunities: 1. Traditional freelance missions These are regular project-based opportunities where the listed mission is the actual project you may work on. 2. AI Lab roles For AI Lab roles, we scout, review, and approve profiles for access to future project opportunities. The missions listed for AI Lab roles are not traditional job openings. AI Lab work is often highly confidential as this exposes information of what an AI Lab is working on, and project requests are unpredictable. When an AI Lab request comes in, we often need to respond within 24 hours with suitable talent. Matching depends on the specific needs of each AI Lab project and your niche expertise. Once your profile is reviewed and approved, you may be matched to relevant AI Lab projects when suitable opportunities arise. This can happen within hours, but it may also take months, depending on the researchers at the AI labs and their project needs.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:421741ef-4e81-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Records Manager based in Spain. This is a flexible, fractional opportunity for an experienced records, compliance, or information governance professional to establish and manage a controlled archive and knowledge-review system. You will play a critical role in determining what information should be preserved, how records are tracked, and what material is ready for entry into a governed knowledge environment. The role combines meticulous records management with responsible use of approved AI tools to accelerate classification and inventory processes. Your judgment will remain central, with every significant AI-assisted decision requiring human verification and careful review. You will work independently, identify risks early, and ensure sensitive information is handled with exceptional discretion. This position is particularly suited to someone who values accuracy, accountability, and strong information governance practices. The engagement is structured as an 8-week pilot with up to 8 hours per week, offering meaningful work without a full-time commitment. Receive, preserve, organize, and track the custody of authorized records and source files throughout the review and archival process. Review incoming information for sensitivity, ownership, completeness, and eligibility for admission into the governed knowledge environment. Use approved AI tools to accelerate information inventory, classification, and review while personally validating all material decisions before they are finalized. Identify and immediately escalate missing, corrupted, incomplete, sensitive, or otherwise high-risk records. Maintain accurate tracking of records, review decisions, outstanding items, and relevant risks. Apply sound professional judgment when determining whether information is suitable for preservation or further review. Provide a concise weekly report covering completed work, remaining backlog, key decisions, and identified risks. Help establish reliable processes and controls for a new or evolving records and knowledge-governance function. Escalate uncertainty or ambiguity rather than making unsupported assumptions, ensuring information is handled consistently and responsibly. Requirements Professional experience in records management, information governance, compliance, audit, legal operations, or a closely related field. Exceptional discretion and demonstrated ability to handle highly confidential or sensitive information responsibly. Strong attention to detail and a high standard for accuracy, documentation, and records integrity. Comfortable working with AI-assisted tools and capable of identifying errors, limitations, or inappropriate recommendations produced by AI. Strong written communication skills, with the ability to document decisions, summarize findings, and communicate risks clearly. Sound judgment and a disciplined approach to escalating uncertainty, inconsistencies, and potential compliance concerns. Ability to work independently and manage responsibilities effectively within a limited-hours engagement. Experience establishing an archive, records-management process, or governance function from the ground up is a plus. Familiarity with legal holds, privacy requirements, cybersecurity practices, or related information governance controls is advantageous. Experience designing human-review controls or quality-assurance processes for AI-assisted workflows is a bonus. A mindset focused on accountability, precision, and preventing unverified information from becoming part of an official knowledge environment. Benefits Fractional contract engagement of up to 8 hours per week. 8-week pilot engagement. Flexible work-from-anywhere arrangement. HMO health insurance. Paid time off. Opportunities for promotion. Potential for pay increases. Opportunity to contribute to the development of a new records and knowledge

jobgether-jobgether:lever:5ba0f671-1b1b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Vice President, Information Security - Manufacturing Plant Security, Product Security & Application Security based in the United States. This executive leadership role will shape and execute a global information security strategy spanning manufacturing, connected products, and application engineering. You will protect critical operational technology environments, IoT-enabled and digital health products, and modern software development ecosystems. Reporting to the CISO, you will lead security strategy across a complex, decentralized global organization operating across more than 50 countries. The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on influence, partnering with business presidents, plant leaders, product executives, and engineering leadership. You will build and develop a global team while establishing consistent security standards, risk frameworks, metrics, and executive reporting. Your work will directly strengthen resilience, regulatory readiness, product trust, and the security of mission-critical operations and technologies. This is a highly visible, remote executive position requiring international travel of up to 30% and the ability to influence at the highest levels of the organization. Define and lead the global information security strategy and execution across manufacturing plant security, product security, and application security. Lead OT/ICS security strategy across manufacturing environments worldwide, establishing effective protections, governance, risk management, and security standards. Own product security strategy for connected and IoT-enabled digital health products, including cybersecurity requirements throughout the product lifecycle. Oversee compliance with applicable FDA medical device cybersecurity requirements, including premarket submissions and post-market vulnerability management. Lead application security across engineering organizations, strengthening CI/CD pipeline security, DevSecOps practices, and modern application security governance. You can choose to work up to 20 hours per week. Start Date: ASAP Employment Type: Independent Contractor/Freelance/Self-Employed Project Duration: Long-term Note: - Even though the position is WFH, you must reside in the country that is noted in this description. This will be automatically checked during the hiring process. Recruitment Process - There is no formal interview for this job! No phone calls, no waiting, and no wasting time wondering whether you got the job or not. - Instead, you will be guided through a self-paced and automated recruitment process.
